home.heroTitle: Your return flight from vacation gives an animal a new home.
home.heroSubtitle: Are you flying back to Germany or to another EU country? Then you can allow a cat or dog to leave your holiday destination safely – free of charge, organised and accompanied by certified animal welfare organisations.
home.heroTrust: 100% free • No additional costs • Accompaniment by animal welfare organisations
home.section2Title: Every year, thousands of animals are waiting for their chance.
home.section2Text: Many rescued dogs and cats have already found a home – but they need someone to accompany them. This is where you come in.
home.benefit1Text: The organisation covers all transport costs. You only accompany the animal on your already planned flight.
home.benefit2Text: Documents, transport box, handover – everything is prepared.
home.benefit3Text: With a single flight, you give a new life to an animal.
home.section3Title: How easy it is to become a flight sponsor
home.step1Text: Search the map for matching transportation requests along your route.
home.step2Text: Contact the organization directly through the platform.
home.step3Text: You travel as planned – and hand over the animal at the destination airport.
home.exampleNote: No additional costs for you. The organization will cover all fees.
home.section5Text: All organizations are checked before activation. Communication and process take place directly via the platform.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Three steps – one more animal in safety.
home.step2CostFree: No cost to you. The organization takes care of everything.
home.step2DetailsText: Cat needs flight from Munich to Zurich for mediation. Travel date flexible. Transport box will be provided by the organization. You only accompany the animal and surrender at the destination.
